entry_state: Beneficial amendments preserve original cost and add separately dated service cost. Participation allocates the ordinary numerator before division; the capped-rights method proves ordering only for complete additive gross effects. Shared bonuses require complete joint worlds and the general selection remains unevaluated. Paragraph57 contingent-option prerequisites are separately taught and checked. The participating-dividend tax example starts on 229 and continues on 230; the awards parent remains open.
exit_state: The awards parent is complete, including the signed participating-tax allocation and its separation from reported profit and journals. Control, acquisition, inventory elimination and functional versus presentation currency have been taught. The foreign-subsidiary lifecycle now reaches the two loss-of-control alternatives and their cash/equity table; its remaining cash and equity reconciliation continues on 236. The lifecycle parent and loss-of-control subsection are still pending.
findings: Actual ordered rendered reading of 230–235 is complete. Twelve specific judgments include five equation rubrics. The awards parent closes at 231; no credit is given for the unfinished foreign-subsidiary lifecycle. No new confirmed manuscript defect. Independent/domain/human acceptance and general method/source residuals remain pending.
